decisions.reason: The client explicitly says the footer works well; adding a subtle internal-page header does not change the footer requirement.
The internal-page header may include the word Confidential, but it does not alter the independently specified final-page distribution warning.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring RR-01 throughout, including in the internal-page header; no additional change is needed.
The new subtle header applies to pages 2 onward and does not change the front-page result dashboard.
The requested internal-page header does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable or how the assessment date and vehicle identity are displayed.
The header applies to internal pages and does not alter the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The candidate already records the message's report-wide refinement direction; the specific header treatment remains owned by the atomic internal-page header requirement.
Adding an internal-page header does not change the mapping of report variants to customer scores, risk bands, or exposure levels.
The header refinement does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or handoff obligations.
The header refinement does not change the required report variants, source editability, PDF export support, or format selection.
